summary: Added a short-lived GitHub Actions artifact for npm audit triage outputs and updated the operational triage documentation.

details: Uploads npm-audit.json and npm-audit-summary.md as npm-audit-triage.
Uses a 7-day retention window and warning-only missing-file behavior.
Documents the GitHub Actions Summary and npm-audit-triage artifact review paths.
Keeps raw audit JSON out of the repository while preserving run-level reviewability.

next_steps: Inspect the npm-audit-triage artifact from the next Security CI run.
Apply targeted dependency updates once vulnerable packages are identified.
Generate and commit package-lock.json with npm@10.8.2 once dependency updates are reviewed.
